task_completion.description: Navigate to the Studio section for the Contacts module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the SuiteCRM Studio interface with the 'Contacts' module selected and the 'Fields' folder visible or open.

task_completion.description: Set the Field Data Type to 'DropDown', Field Name to 'preferred_contact_method', and Display Label to 'Preferred Contact Method'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Add Field' form shows 'Data Type: DropDown', 'Field Name: preferred_contact_method', and 'Display Label: Preferred Contact Method' typed into the fields.

task_completion.description: Create a new dropdown list named 'preferred_contact_method_list' with the specified keys and labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Dropdown Editor' or 'Add Field' screen shows a list containing keys 'phone', 'email', 'sms', and 'mail' with their corresponding labels. The list name is set to 'preferred_contact_method_list'.

task_completion.description: Set the Default Value to 'Email' and ensure 'Required' and 'Audited' are unchecked.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field configuration screen shows 'Default Value' set to 'Email' (or the 'email' key), and the checkboxes for 'Required Field' and 'Audit' are not selected.
The agent clicks the 'Save' button in the Studio field editor, and the field 'preferred_contact_method_c' appears in the list of Contact fields.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the SuiteCRM browser window; no terminal windows showing SQL 'INSERT' or 'ALTER' commands are used to bypass the UI.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Studio component of SuiteCRM.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show the standard SuiteCRM Studio breadcrumbs and sidebar (e.g., Home > Administration > Studio > Contacts > Fields).

integrity.description: The agent followed the constraint to not add the field to any layouts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent does not navigate to 'Layouts' (EditView, DetailView, etc.) or drag the new field onto a layout grid after saving it.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The field name in the database will automatically be appended with '_c' by SuiteCRM, resulting in 'preferred_contact_method_c'. The field type 'DropDown' corresponds to 'enum' in the backend. The dropdown list must be named exactly 'preferred_contact_method_list' and contain the keys: phone, email, sms, mail. The default value must be 'email'.
